raw:
@q query
  select ?w
  rank lowest ?r
  where all
    match
      relation "have pick error rate"
      role subject ?w
      role object ?r
      role time ?t
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "be"
      role subject ?t
      role object "Q2"
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
  compare ?w equal "Brno", compare ?w equal "Poznań", compare ?w equal "Győr"
